name: offgrid
description: Code completion and chat with local models. No account, no cloud: offgrid runs the models on your GPU or CPU.

commands.title: offgrid: Set Up Models and Server

offgrid.completion.enabled.description: Suggest code as you type (inline ghost text).

offgrid.completion.model.description: Code model (GGUF with fill-in-the-middle tokens) for completion. Empty: Qwen2.5-Coder 1.5B, downloaded on first use.

offgrid.completion.debounceMs.description: Wait this long after a keystroke before asking for a completion.

offgrid.completion.timeLimitMs.description: After this much generation time, end the completion at the next line break. 0: no limit.

offgrid.completion.contextSize.description: Context size in tokens for the code model: the code around the cursor plus context from other files. 0: the model's default, at most 8192.

offgrid.chat.enabled.description: Offer a local chat model in the Chat view's model picker. Loading it needs about 3 GB more memory.

offgrid.chat.model.description: Chat model (GGUF). Empty: Qwen3 4B Instruct, downloaded on first use.

offgrid.chat.contextSize.description: Context size in tokens for the chat model. Agent mode sends about 20k tokens of instructions and tools, so it needs 32768. Larger needs more GPU memory. 0: the model's default, at most 8192.

offgrid.chat.expertLayersOnCpu.markdownDescription: For Mixture-of-Experts chat models too large for the GPU (e.g. Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B): keep the expert weights of this many layers in RAM and run them on the CPU, while attention stays on the GPU. Raise it until the model loads; on a 16 GB GPU, 24 works for Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B. 0: off.

enumDescriptions: 8-bit: half the memory of f16, about the same output, a little slower
4-bit: a quarter of the memory; output changes
offgrid.cacheType.description: How the models store their context (KV cache). With q8_0, a 32k chat context for Qwen3 4B needs about 2.4 GB.

offgrid.gpu.description: Run models on the GPU (Vulkan). Off: CPU only.

offgrid.serverPath.description: Use this offgrid-server binary instead of the bundled one.
